courses.note: Elective (pathway course; the major requires five COMP 420+ electives). COMP 560 and COMP 562 are both offered most terms (560 in Spring 2025, Fall 2025, Spring 2026; 562 in every term from Fall 2024 to Spring 2026); COMP 560 chosen as the AI course. The public item is the Spring 2024 course website, which has no AI-use policy; its syllabus proper is on Sakai. No public COMP 562 syllabus after 2018 found (the Fall 2018 site is gone).

courses.note: Required core course (systems programming in C), the required systems course other than C3 (COMP 550 algorithms); COMP 311 is the other required systems core. The Spring 2023 syllabus (section 002) has an honor-code and collaboration policy but no mention of AI. Newer sections (Fall 2025 two sections, Spring 2026 two sections) exist but no public syllabus was found.

notes: Catalog core: COMP 110, 210, 211, 301, 311, 455, 550 plus five COMP 420+ electives. COMP 550 chosen as the algorithms course; COMP 211, 301, 311 are the systems-flavored cores.
